description:
Create HTTP handlers and an orchestration service to run structural and CLI validations against reference scenarios.

Scope:
- Create a validation service that orchestrates: load expectations for a reference → run structural checker → run CLI executor → store results in validation_runs/structural_results/cli_results tables
- Create HTTP handlers (e.g., POST /api/v1/validate/{reference_id} to trigger validation, GET /api/v1/validate/{reference_id}/results to retrieve results)
- Wire handlers into main.go route registration
- The domain logic already exists (domain/validation/structural_checker.go at 89% coverage, domain/validation/cli_executor.go at 91% coverage) — this item is about exposing it via API
- Depends on dtv-sqlite-migration because expectation repos must exist to load expectations for validation
name: dtv-validation-api
title: Validation API Handlers and Service
